summary: A mobile-first app where a field rep records a voice note after a visit and it becomes a structured CRM record.

in: Show, edit and confirm the record
out: Real CRM integrations (use CSV export first)

frontend.why: One codebase, easy to deploy, works on phones

backend.why: Quick to write, good for AI calls

ai.choice: Speech-to-text API + LLM with JSON output

components.name: Web app
components.role: Recording UI, record list, edit screen

flows.name: Voice note to record
steps: API stores audio and queues a job
App shows the record for review

api.purpose: Upload audio and create a visit

phases.name: Voice note to a confirmed record
phases.goal: One rep can record a visit, get a structured record, fix it and confirm it
phases.user_value: Saves the rep about an hour a day of typing
exit_criteria: 5 real reps use it on real visits for a week
At least 8 of 10 records need one edit or fewer
Capture takes under 2 minutes end to end
Cost per visit is logged and within your budget

stages.name: Project skeleton and auth
stages.deliverable: Login page and an empty dashboard, deployed
stages.prompt: Create a Next.js app with Supabase email authentication. Add a protected /dashboard page that shows the signed-in user's email. Use TypeScript and a clean, mobile-first layout. Explain each file you create in one line. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: I can sign up, sign in and sign out
Dashboard is unreachable when signed out

stages.name: Database and visits API
stages.prompt: Add the visits and records tables from the data model using migrations. Build POST /visits and GET /visits in FastAPI, checking the signed-in user. Add tests for both endpoints. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: A visit created by user A is not visible to user B

stages.name: Record and upload audio
stages.goal: Record in the browser and upload
stages.deliverable: Record button, upload progress, saved audio
stages.prompt: Add a record screen that captures microphone audio with the MediaRecorder API, shows a timer, and uploads the file to POST /visits. Handle denied microphone permission with a clear message. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: Permission denied shows a helpful message

stages.name: Transcribe and extract
stages.prompt: Add a background job that transcribes a visit's audio with a speech-to-text API and then calls an LLM to extract customer, outcome, next step and follow-up date as JSON matching a fixed schema. Validate the JSON and retry once on failure. Log the cost per visit. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: 20 sample recordings produce valid JSON at least 90% of the time
Failures are visible in the UI

stages.name: Review and confirm
stages.goal: Let the rep fix and approve a record
stages.deliverable: Edit screen with a Confirm button
stages.prompt: Build a review screen that shows the extracted fields with inline editing and a Confirm button that sets the record status to confirmed. Confirmed records must not change silently. Keep the UI minimal. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: Confirmed records are locked until the rep re-opens them
Edits are saved and shown after a refresh

phases.name: Manager daily digest
phases.goal: A manager gets one summary of yesterday's confirmed visits
phases.why_next: The manager is the buyer, and the digest gives them a reason to pay; the cheap note apps in the case study do not offer it
phases.user_value: Managers see the field without chasing reps
exit_criteria: 3 managers open the digest 3 days in a row
Digest generation cost per team is under your budget

stages.name: Teams and roles
stages.deliverable: teams table, manager role and an invite step
stages.prompt: Add a teams table and a manager role to the existing app. A manager can see confirmed records of reps on their team and nobody else's. Do not change the rep screens. Add tests for the permission rule. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: A manager sees only their team's confirmed records
Reps still see only their own visits

stages.name: Digest job and email
stages.deliverable: Scheduled job that emails a summary per team
stages.prompt: Add a scheduled job that, each morning, summarises yesterday's confirmed records for each team (counts, outcomes, follow-ups due) and emails it to the manager. Keep the summary template in one file. Add an unsubscribe link. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.

phases.name: Offline capture
phases.goal: A rep can record with no signal and have it upload later
phases.why_next: White space in the case study: neither of the main competitors works offline, and field reps often have poor signal
phases.user_value: Reps in poor-signal areas can use the product at all
exit_criteria: A recording made in airplane mode uploads after reconnecting with nothing lost
3 reps in poor-signal areas use it for a week

stages.name: Local queue
stages.goal: Store recordings on the device when offline
stages.deliverable: Service worker and a local queue of pending recordings
stages.prompt: Make the web app installable (PWA) and add a service worker. When the upload fails because the device is offline, store the recording in IndexedDB and show it as 'waiting to upload'. Do not change the online flow. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: An offline recording appears as waiting

stages.name: Sync and retries
stages.goal: Upload the queue when back online
stages.deliverable: Automatic sync with retry and no duplicates
stages.prompt: When the connection returns, upload queued recordings one at a time with retry and exponential backoff. Use a client-generated id so a retried upload never creates a duplicate visit. Show sync status per recording. Add tests for the duplicate rule. Stop when the acceptance checks pass.
acceptance: Interrupting a sync and retrying creates no duplicate visits
Status shows waiting, uploading, done or failed

launch_checklist: Privacy note explaining audio storage and deletion
5 real users testing for a week
risks: Speech accuracy on accents and noise
Storing voice data needs consent and a deletion option
